at-0001.title: Raise BillingError with stable snake_case codes
at-0001.content: Reject invalid billing input by raising BillingError(code, detail) from ledgerly.errors, using the established codes such as "invalid_state", "invalid_quantity" and "negative_amount"; never raise bare ValueError in ledgerly/invoice.py or ledgerly/payments.py.

at-0002.title: Normalize amounts with round_money before storing
at-0002.content: Convert any incoming amount with round_money from ledgerly.money before validating or storing it, and compare against ZERO rather than a literal Decimal; store the rounded value on the model.

at-0003.title: Reject bools when validating integer fields
at-0003.content: When validating an integer argument, exclude bool explicitly (isinstance(x, bool)) before the int check, since True/False pass isinstance(int) and would otherwise be accepted as quantities.

at-0004.title: Normalize datetimes with ensure_utc
at-0004.content: In ledgerly, normalize every incoming datetime with `ensure_utc` from `ledgerly.clock` before comparing or doing arithmetic (see `current_period` in `ledgerly/subscriptions.py`).

at-0005.title: Money-moving functions accept idempotency_key
at-0005.content: Every function that moves money or changes a payment, credit or invoice balance must accept a keyword-only `idempotency_key=None`. Check it first via `ledgerly.audit.events()` and return the original record without reapplying; include `idempotency_key` in the `audit.record` entry.

review_comments: [team convention] Every operation that moves money or changes a payment, credit or invoice balance must accept an optional keyword-only `idempotency_key=None` (callers without a key keep working). Check the key first, before validating state: if an audit entry with the same key already exists (ledgerly.audit.events()), return the original result (for functions that return a record, the same record) without applying the operation again. Include `idempotency_key` in the audit entry you write. Introduced after the double-refund incident INC-204.

[team convention] Support-initiated refunds and credits above 500.00 need a second approver (finance policy FIN-2026-03): accept an optional keyword-only `approved_by=None` (callers that do not need approval keep working). Amounts at or below 500.00 need no approval; above it, raise BillingError("approval_required") when `approved_by` is missing.
